# gRPC Client v1.0.2 - Table of Contents

> gRPC client implementation for Elixir

## Pages

- [gRPC Elixir Client](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

- Getting Started
  - [Client](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/client.md)

- Advanced
  - [Custom Codecs](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/custom_codecs.md)
  - [Load Balancing](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/load_balancing.md)

## Modules

- [GRPC.Client.Adapters.Gun.ConnectionProcess](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.Adapters.Gun.ConnectionProcess.md): Owns long-lived Gun connections on behalf of the Gun adapter.
- [GRPC.Client.Adapters.Gun.StreamResponseProcess](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.Adapters.Gun.StreamResponseProcess.md): Owns response state for a single Gun request stream.
- [GRPC.Client.DNSResolver](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.DNSResolver.md): Dedicated process for periodic DNS re-resolution.
- [GRPC.Client.Interceptor](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.Interceptor.md): Interceptor on client side. See `GRPC.Stub.connect/2`.

- [GRPC.Client.Interceptors.Logger](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.Interceptors.Logger.md): Print log around client rpc calls, like
- [GRPC.Client.Resolver.DNS.Adapter](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.Resolver.DNS.Adapter.md): Adapter to resolve DNS (A and TXT).

- [GRPC.Client.ServiceConfig](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.ServiceConfig.md): Represents the gRPC `ServiceConfig` parsed from JSON, which can come from DNS TXT records or xDS.

- Client Core
  - [GRPC.Channel](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Channel.md): A struct to store the connection data, which should be passed to
RPC functions as the first argument
  - [GRPC.Client.Connection](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.Connection.md): Connection manager for gRPC client channels, with optional load balancing
and name resolution support.
  - [GRPC.Client.Stream](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.Stream.md): A struct that *streaming* clients get from rpc function calls and use to send further requests.
  - [GRPC.Stub](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Stub.md): A module acting as the interface for gRPC client.

- Adapters
  - [GRPC.Client.Adapter](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.Adapter.md): HTTP client adapter for GRPC.

  - [GRPC.Client.Adapters.Gun](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.Adapters.Gun.md): A client adapter using Gun.
  - [GRPC.Client.Adapters.Mint](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.Adapters.Mint.md): A client adapter using Mint.

- Load Balancing
  - [GRPC.Client.LoadBalancing](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.LoadBalancing.md): Load balancing behaviour for gRPC clients.
  - [GRPC.Client.LoadBalancing.PickFirst](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.LoadBalancing.PickFirst.md): Pick-first load balancer: always returns the first channel in the list.
  - [GRPC.Client.LoadBalancing.RoundRobin](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.LoadBalancing.RoundRobin.md): Round-robin load balancer: cycles through the channels, one per pick.

- Resolvers
  - [GRPC.Client.Resolver](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.Resolver.md): Behaviour for gRPC client resolvers.
  - [GRPC.Client.Resolver.DNS](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.Resolver.DNS.md): DNS Resolver for gRPC targets, supporting dynamic updates via a GenServer.
  - [GRPC.Client.Resolver.IPv4](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.Resolver.IPv4.md): Resolver for gRPC clients connecting to one or more IPv4 addresses.
  - [GRPC.Client.Resolver.IPv6](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.Resolver.IPv6.md): Resolver for gRPC clients connecting to one or more IPv6 addresses.
  - [GRPC.Client.Resolver.Unix](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.Client.Resolver.Unix.md): Resolver for gRPC clients connecting via Unix Domain Sockets (UDS).

- Deprecated
  - [GRPC.ClientInterceptor](https://grpc.hexdocs.pm/GRPC.ClientInterceptor.md): Interceptor on client side. See `GRPC.Stub.connect/2`.
